verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for an OTP generator, but the evidence documents only an interactive mobile app operated by taps, swipes, and QR scanning. The GitHub items mention mobile-platform implementations and a PAM module for server-side verification. Neither is a documented headless, CLI, or CI mode for running the product, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
